newsitem.title: UK: Secret budget documents returned to government - paper.
newsitem.headline: Secret budget documents returned to government - paper.

text.p: Top secret documents linked to Tuesday's annual budget have been returned to the government after being passed to the Daily Mirror newspaper.
The paper, one of Britain's leading tabloids, said in a statement issued on Monday that the 36 documents revealed changes in a wide range of taxes.

Mirror editor Piers Morgan said publication of such detailed information before finance minister Kenneth Clarke delivers his budget statement on Tuesday "could have forced the stock market to close and cause chaos in the international money markets".
Details of the annual budget delivered to parliament are one of the most closely guarded secrets in the British government.
The Mirror said the top secret documents ran to about 100 pages. No further details were immediately available.
